verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Cloud Firestore as a managed database that stores and syncs data without managing servers. Client apps can read, write, listen to and query it, including offline with realtime sync. Server-side access is evidenced by MongoDB-compatible drivers, a production report of APIs running on Functions with Firestore, and CLI/MCP tooling that creates projects and works with database data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the database provisioning flow, and first-party detail on the server/Admin SDK read/write API (the Admin SDK appears only as a Functions trigger source).
